Nestled on 5.5 acres in the heart of charming Franklin, TN, Cabin Creek Farm is just 3 miles from Main Street and 20 minutes to Nashville. A unique property that is "away from it all" yet "close to everything." Cabin Creek Farm is the perfect choice for families, couples, or corporate meetings. Beautiful outdoor gardens include a stone patio, fire pit, and seating- an ideal setting for your evening soirée. You are going to LOVE Cabin Creek Farm!

Instagram: @cabincreekfarmfranklin

The space
This 2 story home, while traditional on the exterior, has every modern touch and amenities on the inside. From the moment you open the door to begin your stay at Cabin Creek Farm, you'll notice that careful attention has been paid to every detail.  

The warm entryway welcomes you into the expansive, open kitchen and family living area that is the heartbeat of this home.  This comfortable, yet stylish space will no doubt be the gathering place for your family or group throughout your stay.  You can't help but come together here...whether it's over a lazy breakfast, cocktail "hour", a decadent dinner, or late night conversation.  Unwind, have fun and enjoy the relaxed style of a property that was created with your comfort and happiness in mind.  Curl up in your new favorite chair and watch a movie on the flatscreen, listen to the music of your choice on our Bluetooth sound system or, better yet, spend some time free of technology and check out our wide assortment of games and puzzles for all ages...nothing says family fun (or fun in general), like a good ole game!  

The master on the main is a beautiful oasis.  With a king bed, luxury linens and bedding, flatscreen television, plush carpet, a walk-in closet, and full bath with a jacuzzi tub...you might just want to skip the Honkey Tonks!  

Upstairs, you will be afforded as much privacy as you wish as there's a door that completely separates the first story from the second. This can be ideal for couples vacationing together, or couples/groups with children, who prefer to keep the evening going long after bedtime for the little ones.  

There on the second level, you'll find yet another beautifully appointed king room with its own flatscreen television, and a walk-in closet spacious enough to be a perfect "nursery" set up for a baby or toddler, and make it a lovely, quiet spot for your little one to get a good nights sleep or a long nap, while mom and dad are able to enjoy their vacation too.  

A third spacious bedroom is also located on the second floor.  This serene space has two plush queen beds, luxurious linens, beautiful wooded views, and a sitting area to relax and listen to the sounds of nature just beyond the window. 

Outside you'll find wooded, private grounds complete with a moss fairy garden!  You'll also have some up close and personal moments with the many deer families that tend to happen by each day.  Spend as much time as you like wandering the property, or relax with a good book on the beautifully furnished back deck nestled in the woods.  You could always grill a fabulous meal for your crew and dine under the stars, then maybe even let us arrange a night for you and yours around the fire pit, complete with s'mores!  There is also an organic herb garden.

Cabin Creek Farm is equipped with everything you could possibly need to enjoy your stay...and then some!

Guest access
The main house and front patio are yours to enjoy!  There is a second "Cottage" house on the property that is available for an additional rate and also books separately.  It has 1 Full Bedroom, Living Room with Sofa Bed, Full Bathroom, Kitchen, Dining and Private Patio.  The Cottage is great for extra guests and makes the perfect mother-in-law suite.  The Cottage + Cottage patio are not included with the main house rental.  There is a separate listing called The Cottage at Cabin Creek Farm.

The space
Welcome to the farm house at Rock Ridge Retreat.

What’s magical about this incredible property is not just the forest and nature all around you, but the home itself is simply teeming with love and personal affection. Just like most cabins in the woods, it comes with its squeaks and rustic aesthetics, but what is truly remarkable is the hand-built touches you will see displayed throughout… The original owners were a loving couple comprised of a carpenter and an artist who specialized in pottery who lived here for almost 40 yrs. You will see their finger prints everywhere you look, from hand carved staircases to hand kilned tile and ceramic walls/floors!

Despite not being an overly large home, we do feature 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms and can accommodate groups of up to 14 guests.
3 of the bedrooms are located up the hand carved spiral staircase and they share the use of 2 full bathrooms. The master suite includes a king sized bed and has direct bathroom access. Both secondary bedrooms on this floor contain queen size beds.
Downstairs you will find a cozy living room that has a pull out queen size sleeper sofa if needed. This living room opens into the fully equipped kitchen which in-turn is directly adjacent to 2 dining areas and a glass sunroom. There are plenty of places to sit and enjoy a meal together or watch the plethora of wildlife that has a habit of simply strolling through the woods right outside your windows!
Up another short staircase is our 4th bedroom which also has it’s own private entrance. This room is set up great for kids and we fondly refer to it as ‘the bunk room’. This bedroom includes a full bed and 4 twin sized beds in bunk formation and can sleep upto 6 kids comfortably. It also has its own newly renovated en-suite bathroom. Close the door to this room and the kids can make as much noise as they like!

Designed to accommodate family adventures, we have taken the time to provide several games, puzzles, toys, stuffed animals and even a large box of legos to keep kids occupied for hours.

In addition to a decent sized pantry and plenty of cabinet space to store groceries, we have a stackable washer/dryer to allow washing of towels and clothes during your stay.

We do want to let all guests know that despite us having almost 66 acres, we do prohibit any guests from hunting on the premises for the safety of others and deer trails are naturally overgrown from spring-fall so it's not navigable during these seasons. Once the leaves drop towards winter time, the woods are much more open but they are still very steep in places. A waterfall does nestle down in the valley and we will endeavor to provide a recommended way to reach it in the winter, but know that this is a strenuous hike and shouldn't be attempted by young children, elderly or anyone suffering from ailments or pregnant. Please enjoy the immediate areas around the farm house if you have to take your dogs out for a walk. Please keep them on a leash and clean up any mess after you.

Lastly, there are two buildings located either side of the farmhouse that will be renovated to provide additional accommodations within our woodland retreat once completed. As we know that renovations can be noisy at times, we have not only requested that our contractors keep the noise level to a minimum and refrain from working on weekends, but we have decided that the pricing we set for the farmhouse during this time-period is reduced from what the standard rates will be going forward in the future. All pricing you see listed has already taken that reduction into account. If you feel that having some renovations going on at adjacent buildings during your stay is not what you and your group are seeking, then we encourage you to not book with us at this time and consider booking with us in the future once everything is completed!

Thank you for your understanding.

Enjoy the outdoor features such as our stunning fire pit illuminated by fairy lights in the woods. Gather around the patio table for a burger you’ve fixed up on the charcoal grill. Inside you’ll find, not only a slate bed pool table and a full size ping pong table, but as you may have seen in our pictures, we have a golf driving range! That’s right, step right up onto the driving mat and challenge your friends to some target practice right here in your garage, play a championship course, or simply work on your swing…

With a house set up like this, you’d expect to be tucked in the mountains miles away from civilization, but this isn’t the case for our Mountain Hideaway. In fact, you are just 2 minutes from grocery stores such as Kroger & Target. Of course, most of the water-front restaurants feature live music throughout the peak season!

It is a long gated driveway and it is not salted. Please plan accordingly if you book to stay with us during this season by taking extra precautions and purchasing travel insurance. See you soon!
